jsonld.name: SOHO Wellness & Med Spa
jsonld.description: Family-run med spa in Tampa, FL offering Botox, dermal fillers, facials, massage, laser and skin treatments across three Tampa Bay locations.

parrafo.es: SOHO Wellness & Med Spa es un spa familiar en una casa restaurada del sur de Tampa: Botox y rellenos, faciales avanzados, masaje terapéutico, láser y sauna infrarrojo, con tres ubicaciones en Tampa Bay.
parrafo.en: SOHO Wellness & Med Spa is a family-run spa inside a restored South Tampa house: Botox and fillers, advanced facials, therapeutic massage, laser treatments and infrared sauna, across three Tampa Bay locations.

hero.imagen_alt: Recepción de SOHO Wellness & Med Spa con el letrero de madera y escritorio moderno

parrafo_1.es: SOHO Wellness & Med Spa nació en 2015 cuando Debbie y su hija Becky, esteticista, decidieron unir sus servicios bajo un mismo techo: una casa restaurada del sur de Tampa, sobre Kennedy Blvd, con estacionamiento propio.
parrafo_1.en: SOHO Wellness & Med Spa began in 2015 when Debbie and her daughter Becky, an esthetician, decided to combine their services under one roof: a restored house in South Tampa, just off Kennedy Blvd, with its own parking lot.

parrafo_2.es: Hoy el equipo atiende Botox y rellenos, faciales, masaje, sauna infrarrojo y láser en tres ubicaciones de Tampa Bay: Tampa, Wesley Chapel y Westchase, con 101 reseñas verificadas y 4.8 de calificación.
parrafo_2.en: Today the team handles Botox and fillers, facials, massage, infrared sauna and laser across three Tampa Bay locations: Tampa, Wesley Chapel and Westchase, with 101 verified reviews and a 4.8 rating.

texto.es: Nos llamas al (813) 512-6920 o reservas online, eliges ubicación (Tampa, Wesley Chapel o Westchase) y servicio.
texto.en: Call us at (813) 512-6920 or book online, pick your location (Tampa, Wesley Chapel or Westchase) and service.

texto.es: Te reciben en la sala de estar de la casa restaurada, con bata y pantuflas mientras esperas tu turno.
texto.en: You are welcomed into the restored house's lounge, with a robe and slippers while you wait for your turn.

texto.es: Botox, relleno, facial, masaje o láser: cada servicio lo hace un especialista dedicado a esa área.
texto.en: Botox, filler, facial, massage or laser: each service is handled by a specialist dedicated to that area.

texto.es: Terminas con recomendaciones de cuidado y, si quieres, tu próxima cita ya agendada.
texto.en: You leave with aftercare recommendations and, if you want, your next visit already booked.

nota.es: Precios de referencia publicados por SOHO Wellness. Fillers, láser y paquetes se cotizan según la consulta.
nota.en: Reference prices as published by SOHO Wellness. Fillers, laser and packages are quoted at consultation.

texto.es: Botox, Dysport y Jeuveau desde $12 por unidad. Una sesión típica usa entre 15 y 50 unidades.
texto.en: Botox, Dysport and Jeuveau starting at $12 per unit. A typical session uses 15 to 50 units.

texto.es: Resurfacing láser Clear + Brilliant combinado con una sesión de terapia IV, en un solo paquete.
texto.en: Clear + Brilliant laser resurfacing combined with one IV therapy session, bundled into a single package.

texto.es: Rellenos dérmicos Juvéderm, Radiesse, Restylane, RHA y Skinvive. Precio según zona y producto en tu consulta.
texto.en: Juvéderm, Radiesse, Restylane, RHA and Skinvive dermal fillers. Priced by area and product at your consultation.

texto.es: Morpheus8, Lumecca IPL, laser hair removal, HydraFacial, DiamondGlow, AquaGold y peelings químicos.
texto.en: Morpheus8, Lumecca IPL, laser hair removal, HydraFacial, DiamondGlow, AquaGold and chemical peels.

pie.es: Masaje, sauna infrarrojo, mani/pedi y cera también disponibles. Consulta el menú completo por teléfono.
pie.en: Massage, infrared sauna, mani/pedi and waxing also available. Ask for the full menu by phone.

items.quote: I chose the Soho experience package. Hands down best experience I have ever had with getting a massage. I was very relaxed, tension-free, with no discomfort/pain. Deborah was nice and very helpful.
I came to Natalie for Botox and she was fantastic! Super knowledgeable, explained why she was injecting which spots, and was very consultative. Highly recommend!
Amanda was excellent. She provided a deep tissue massage that targeted the areas of concern and I rescheduled an appointment immediately.
